summary: Iteration 4 validates the user's 'too slow / need stop button' fixes: storyboard mode, stop/cancel/pause endpoints, mode routing, local-Qwen fallback, PIL storyboard poster. Backend pytest 13/14 pass (1 failure was cross-worker pause-state race — passes when run alone). Stop button + queue pause + job-cancel endpoints all work; per-story stop kicked in on a live 12-min produce job and cleanly returned the story to script_ready 'Stopped by user' with the produce job marked cancelled. Storyboard PIL fallback module verified. Existing storyboard demo 6aa616a70b6da578466afad5 has valid grid poster + 6 differing tiles + final video (intact). Slide-mode demo 6aa57c1eaad23f394fffaa41.mp4 intact (not re-rendered). Engagement sync completes with Ollama absent (fallback works). New Gemini + OpenAI keys are set in vault. FE: /create shows all three mode-radios with Instant storyboard visually default-selected; dashboard has queue-pause-button + paused badge + per-job Stop buttons (job-cancel-{id}); story detail during rendering shows stop-render-button. CRITICAL FINDING: the storyboard-mode E2E timing goal is NOT met on this environment. A fresh 45s / 4-segment storyboard story ran for 740s (>12 min) and was still stuck in the 'Metadata' LLM stage when I stopped it: Script ~90s → Fact check ~40s → Storyboard poster ~290s (Gemini image API retries + fallback loops) → QA ~40s → Metadata >200s (LLM provider chain retries; OpenAI chat returns 'no credits remaining' and gemini image retries burn wall time). The user's original 'render takes 12+ min' complaint reproduces under the current provider outage state.

critical.issue: 45s / 4-seg storyboard render did not reach in_review within the 5-min success budget — sat at >12min still on 'Metadata' stage. Root cause: image-provider retry loops in services/media.generate_image (gemini image) + LLM provider chain in metadata/qa are eating minutes per call because OpenAI returns 'no credits remaining' 100% and gemini image keeps retrying with exponential backoff via litellm. The storyboard slicing itself is fast — the surrounding LLM/image cascade is the bottleneck. Consider (a) tightening litellm num_retries / max_retries on image + chat calls, (b) short-circuiting a provider for the remainder of a produce_video run after N consecutive failures, (c) allowing metadata to fall back to a canned template like the PIL poster does, (d) making the storyboard AI-poster attempt subject to a hard wall-clock timeout (e.g. 20s) before dropping to PIL.

minor.issue: Passes serially; fails under -n 2 loadscope because another class (TestCancelJob) mutates the same shared QUEUE_PAUSED flag → cross-worker interference. Not a product bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Mode badge line 84 only handles clip vs slide → storyboard stories are mislabeled 'Slide-based'. Should render 'Instant storyboard' when story.mode === 'storyboard'.
Carry-over from iter_1/2/3 — 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' console warning still present.
Small red 'Failed' toast appeared during my rapid Pause→Resume toggle test; likely from another concurrent action, but toast copy is generic and non-actionable.

action_items: Fix StoryDetailPage.jsx:84 mode badge — add storyboard label (e.g. story.mode === 'storyboard' ? 'Instant storyboard' : story.mode === 'clip' ? 'AI video clips' : 'Slide-based').

CRITICAL: cap per-call wall time on services/media.generate_image and services/llm.ask_json (or lower litellm num_retries) so a single flaky provider cannot burn 3-5 minutes. Applies to storyboard-poster, QA, Metadata, and improvement-coach paths — current retry cascade is the reason a 4-seg storyboard render was still not done at 12 min in this iteration.

Consider a canned/PIL fallback for metadata generation (title/description/hashtags) analogous to the PIL storyboard poster fallback, so complete provider outage doesn't block the pipeline from reaching in_review.
Optional: keep the paused-queue test isolated via serial marker or module-scope xfail under -n 2 (test-side only).
critical_code_review_comments: services/storyboard.py is clean & self-contained (~130 lines). Poster tile slicing is correct; PIL fallback works with no APIs.
job_queue.CANCELLED set + JobCancelled exception is a solid cooperative-cancel design; stop endpoint updates BOTH job status and story status atomically enough (two updates but cheap).

POST /queue/pause persists to db.settings.queue.paused — good for surviving worker restarts, but recover() at start_workers does not read it back into QUEUE_PAUSED['paused']. If backend is restarted while paused, the queue silently unpauses. Suggest reading db.settings.queue on start_workers and hydrating QUEUE_PAUSED.

services/llm.py prefer_local ollama fallback is correctly non-fatal (fails fast when OLLAMA_BASE_URL unset), but the fall-through to the cloud chain still uses the full retry ladder — this is what makes the storyboard render slow. prefer_local currently does not shorten cloud retries.

routes.py stop_story does NOT verify permission/session — anon can stop any story's job. Same for /queue/pause. Given auth is optional app-wide right now that matches existing pattern, but worth calling out for the eventual multi-tenant model.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all testids resolve, stop/pause/cancel wired, storyboard mode card present + default; 1 mode-badge label bug)

TestQueuePause needs serial run under -n 2 (or leave the one failure — it's not a product bug). The storyboard 5-min timing budget is NOT met on this env because of provider retry cascades — see backend.err.log for gemini-image + OpenAI 'no credits remaining' retries. Story 6aa622fec2babed4d6ed2950 was mid-'Metadata' when stopped at 740s.
rca_of_the_issue: User's complaint: 'voice generation taking too long, need stop button'. Voice generation itself is fine (Kokoro CPU ~10-25s/seg). The real time-sink in a storyboard render on this env is the retry cascade in LLM + image provider chain: (1) Gemini image API returns errors, litellm retries with backoff (multiple rounds visible in backend.err.log), then falls through to next provider that also errors, before the PIL fallback is finally reached — this consumed ~5 min in the poster stage of the fresh story. (2) Metadata LLM stage hit OpenAI which returns 'RateLimitError: no credits remaining' — again through full retry ladder, another 3+ min. Stop button works and unblocks user immediately, which IS the primary UX fix requested — but the underlying rendering budget is still bad. Recommended: hard per-call timeouts + provider circuit-breakers per produce_video run.
